title.narrative: Health and Child Protection Response to High-Need Communities: Strengthening Resilience in Underserved Areas

description.narrative: ltpgtIMC is proposing a one-year humanitarian response to enhance resilience for the most affected populations in Az Zabadani (Madaya) and Babella in Rural Damascus, aligning with the HRP 2024 strategic objectives. This solutions-oriented Resilience Program Framework aims to address the multifaceted Syria crisis by improving the resilience and self-reliance of crisis-affected communities through an integrated multisectoral response. ltbrgtTo combat the negative effects on healthcare access from the conflict, IMC plans to rehabilitate the Madaya Primary Healthcare Centre (PHCC) and deploy a Mobile Medical Team (MMT). The PHCC, essential for the Madaya catchment area, currently suffers from electricity shortages impacting service continuity. Rehabilitation will involve installing a solar energy system to enhance laboratory and dental services and ensure proper medicine storage, thus improving primary healthcare delivery. ltbrgtFurthermore, in Babella, comprehensive Child Protection (CP) services will be offered to victims of abuse, neglect, and violence, including specialized mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) for children with disabilities and their caregivers in Babella catchment area. IMC will also engage in national advocacy and coordination efforts to support child protection initiatives in Syria. ltbrgt* International Medical Corps (IMC) is a US-registered independent affiliate organization of International Medical Corps (UK), IMC UK, with which IMC UK shares the same name and charitable objectives and mission. IMC UK and IMC work together to deliver assistance programs in an accountable and effective manner in pursuit of their commonly-held charitable objectives. IMC UK will engage IMC to implement its programmes in the field, with IMC UK oversight, according to the terms and conditions of the agreement that results from this proposal and the terms of the parties’ administrative service agreement. Together with IMC Croatia, IMC provides administrative and operational support to IMC UK and to the programmes on the ground, including but not limited to financial management, banking and cash management, procurement management/international procurements and logistics.ltbrgt lt/pgt
